compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner selling an AI product and engineering delivery, rather than the staffing and recruiting agency described in the company documents. It also contains unsupported performance, security, timeline, contact, and company-history claims that should not be carried into a rewrite.

llm_problems.fix: Replace this positioning with the approved company description and the two services in the company documents.
